name: Mymensingh
registryBasis: The official DLRS Mymensingh Zonal Settlement Office serves Mymensingh district; official land-record/survey services include mouza maps and cadastral/plot map searches. A public map-search client can load full per-sheet GeoJSON/vector tiles by administrative map selectors. For this city, public selectors returned Mymensingh district and one RS survey but zero thana/upazila units; no Mymensingh Sadar sheet or exact WUP polygon could be queried.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: No full parcel polygon at the exact WUP point was received. MapSearch route makes per-sheet full GeoJSON available after selecting a map unit; this district’s public survey selector returned no upazila choices. No tile was treated as a full geometry sample.
scopeLimits: Bounded public-source and anonymous service review only. No owner, address, applicant, account, taxpayer, identity or property-specific query inputs were submitted. No geometry sample is retained.
remainingUncertainty: Whether a current cadastral sheet covers the urban WUP locator is unknown; the listed public RS survey had no upazila map units. The national land-zoning site is a distinct project and its geometry/registry semantics were not established.

officialSources.observation: Official DLRS Mymensingh office page lists the Mymensingh Zonal Settlement Officer under the Department of Land Records and Surveys.
Official DLRS directory assigns Mymensingh district to the Mymensingh Zonal Settlement Office and lists survey/mouza map services.
Official DLRS map-search page exposes administrative selectors for survey, district, upazila, mouza, sheet and dag; HTML shell returned HTTP 200.
Official Smart Bhumi Naksha page explains a mouza/plot land-use zoning program; it is not itself proof of cadastral parcel-vector coverage.
Official Mymensingh district map page offers district map material, not parcel vectors.
Official Mymensingh Sadar government service-process page includes land-record correction and khatiyan copy services; it supports local land-record activity, not anonymous parcel-vector geometry.
